sentence: The seat became vacant after the Speaker of the National Assembly, Nelly Mutti, declared it so due to the prolonged absence of the incumbent MP, Tasila Lungu.
context: The seat became vacant after the Speaker of the National Assembly, Nelly Mutti, declared it so due to the prolonged absence of the incumbent MP, Tasila Lungu. The Speaker invoked Article 72(2)(c) of the Constitution of Zambia following Lungu's absence during events related to her father's burial delays.
